[[Saevio's Maul]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] dropped by [[Saevio Proelium]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Domain of Pain]].

==Stats==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Energy]] -5
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Desolation Maul]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Bludgeoner]] from crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Furious]] [[Hammer Haft]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hammer Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[hammer]]s:
**[[Barrel Hammer]] from crafters [[Bolereh]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Ram's Hammer]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Maul]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Hammer]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Maul]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Dwarven Hammer]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Hammer of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Maul]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Hammer]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Maul]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Maul]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Maul]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
